thread:
kai: Heads-up: we saw a burst of schema validation failures on the payments.tool call after yesterday's strict rollout slice. Ops only noticed because a customer complained.
elin: Was that the usual casing issue or something else?
kai: Mixed bag. Example from the logs: ```json
{"id": "tx_9X", "amount": 10.00, "currency": "usd", "method": {"type": "card", "last4": 1234}}
``` The validator expects amount to be integer cents, and last4 as string. Also some adapters sent extra metadata.meta fields we don't recognize.
jess: Oof. So two problems: type coercion and unknown extra fields. Both caused rejects under strict.
marco: Quick triage: how many rejects, and did they come from a single integrator?
kai: ~120 rejects over 2 hours, ~70% from one integrator shard. Sampling in Dashboard only captured 2 payloads, both unhelpful.
elin: We need four things: 1) short-term mitigation (make these rejects non-billable during canary), 2) validator fallback policy, 3) console visibility improvements, 4) better sampling when rejects spike.
jess: On (1) I agree. Billing noise is worst for customer trust. Can we emit an event label like validation.phase=canary and validation.outcome=rejected_nonbillable and wire billing to exclude it?
billing-bot: I can file a billing exclusion change but it needs finance sign-off. Recommend tagging invoice-control.
marco: For (2) propose a small decision table in PR: 
- TYPE_MISMATCH (numeric vs string): attempt coercion if lossless, mark `validator.outcome=coerced`, let it through in canary; otherwise reject.
- EXTRA_FIELDS: allow through in permissive canary, capture diff.
- MISSING_REQUIRED: hard reject always.
Also add a strictness flag per-route (per-route.strict_level = [permissive, coercive, strict]).
elin: Good. For coercion semantics: amount -> if floats -> multiply to cents if within epsilon, coerce; last4 -> stringify numbers. Add a coercion_summary in logs.
jess: For (3) Console UX: we need a tiny payload-diff panel in the route details page that shows expected vs actual with inline highlights, and a toggle to "share sample with integrator" that posts to a configured webhook. Also surface a per-route badge: validation=(ok|coerced|rejected).
kai: I mocked something here: https://figma.redwood/u/console/val-diff-2 . Mock shows a compact diff, a one-click copy, and a link to replay the exact request from the Console.
elin: Replay will be useful for integrators. Ensure replays get sanitized (strip PII) unless owner opts in.
marco: On (4) sampling: current uniform sampling fails for low-rate errors. Suggest adaptive sampling config (pseudo): 
```yaml
validation_sampling:
  strategy: adaptive
  baseline_pct: 0.005
  spike_pct: 0.4
  spike_window_seconds: 60
  spike_threshold: 5
  max_store_per_minute: 200
```
When rejects per minute exceed spike_threshold, jump to spike_pct for spike_window_seconds.
jess: Also emit metric labels: validation.outcome in traces (ok/coerced/rejected) and validation.coercions list attribute so queries can filter by coercion type.
marco: Great. Operationally, I want a pre-rollout compatibility run: run traffic through a shadow validator for 24-48h that reports diffs and top-n offending integrators. That should be part of the rollout checklist.
kai: Who will own the shadow job? Platform infra to implement, eng-platform to run and analyze. I can start a minimal job that replays sampled production requests into the shadow validator and collects diffs.
elin: Assignments: kai -> create shadow-run tracker & start sampling tweak, jess -> draft billing exclusion request and contact invoice-control, marco -> PR with decision table + validator flags, and I'll create Console ticket for payload-diff + replay (include mock).
jess: One more: update rollout docs to require enabling permissive/coerce mode with adaptive sampling for 72h and a compatibility run before escalating to hard strict. Add a note: any route that receives >50 rejects/day in permissive should not be flipped to strict.
kai: Sounds good. I'll post a short incident note for the customer and link this thread. If folks see more rejects, paste sample ids here.
marco: Also add automated alert: if coerced_count / total_validations > 0.05 for 30m, trigger an ops channel notification and increase sampling automatically.
elin: Adding that to telemetry spec as well. Ok team, thanks. We'll sync tomorrow in 11:00 eng-platform stand.
